descriptionEn: Kaohsiung is an important city in southern Taiwan, boasting a rich fishing port culture and bustling night markets, making it a great place for food and leisure.
name: 高雄

description: 高雄是台灣南部的重要城市，擁有豐富的漁港文化與熱鬧的夜市，是美食與休閒的好去處。
